newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine extends privatisation voucher deadline.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine extends privatisation voucher deadline.

text.p: Ukraine has again extended the deadline for Ukrainians to pick up their privatisation certificates, this time until July 1, 1997.

Parliamentary deputies who voted to change the deadline from December 31 said about 15 percent of Ukrainians have yet to pick up their certificates, worth about $275 each, to be used to buy shares in state-owned enterprises undergoing privatisation.
This is the third extension this year, but the deadline to invest the certificates remains December 31, 1997.
Investment companies have been buying the certificates from cash-strapped Ukrainians for $7 to $9 each.
